notes: Upstream test race, cited and not disclosed (COORD ruling, 2026-10-09): TestVersion6 can fail on either runtime with "time reversed". In google/uuid v1.6.0, NewV6 writes the version nibble over bits 12-15 of the timestamp and Time() reads those bits back, so the test fails whenever the timestamp crosses a multiple of 409.6 microseconds between its two NewV6 calls. Native Go fails it about 3 times in 20,000 runs. This proof is a run in which both sides passed.
